description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'KpiDaoTest' for testing the 'KpiDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes setup, various test methods for CRUD operations on KPIs, and interacts with entity classes like 'Kpi' and filter parameters.

classes.name: KpiDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing 'KpiDao' methods related to KPI management within the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of 'KpiDao', and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests the saving of a new KPI and verifies it returns the same KPI object.

methods.name: testGetKpiById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a KPI by ID and checks its properties; tests retrieval of a non-existing KPI.

methods.name: testGetKpiList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of KPI list with and without filters, verifying count and content.

methods.name: testGetKpiCount
methods.description: Verifies KPI count with different filter conditions.

methods.name: testDeleteKpi
methods.description: Tests deletion of KPIs and verifies the number of deletions performed.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Ensures the default KPI is unset when invoked.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpiWithId
methods.description: Verifies setting a specific KPI as not default.

methods.name: testGetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the default KPI.
